body.zh-Hant: 土耳其大國民議會的歷任首相傳記寫道，穆罕默德·舒克魯·薩拉吉奧盧1887年生於伊茲密爾省的奧代米什，1909年自行政學校（Mülkiye Mektebi）畢業，之後在伊茲密爾的中學任教。德國國家圖書館人名權威檔把他歸為土耳其政治人物，生日記為1887年，並註明他1942至1946年任總理；同一傳記標題行寫的是1886年，兩者不一致，見缺漏紀錄。
body.en: The Turkish Grand National Assembly's prime-ministers volume says that Mehmet Şükrü Saraçoğlu was born in 1887 in Ödemiş in the province of İzmir, graduated from the Mülkiye school in 1909 and then taught in İzmir secondary schools. The German National Library authority record lists him as a Turkish politician born in 1887 and notes that he was prime minister from 1942 to 1946; the heading line of the same biography gives 1886, an inconsistency recorded in the gaps.

citations.quote: Mülkiye Mektebi’ni (1909) bitirdikten sonra İzmir liselerinde öğretmenlik yaptı.

body.zh-Hant: 傳記寫他以伊茲密爾議員身分進入第二屆大國民議會，在費特希·奧卡爾政府任國民教育部長（1924至1925），在第四、第五屆伊諾努政府任財政部長（1927至1930），1933至1939年任司法部長，1939至1942年任外交部長。1942年他受命組閣。
body.en: The biography says he joined the second-term Grand National Assembly as an İzmir deputy, served as Minister of National Education in the Fethi Okyar government (1924–1925), as Minister of Finance in the fourth and fifth İnönü governments (1927–1930), as Minister of Justice in 1933–1939 and as Minister of Foreign Affairs in 1939–1942. In 1942 he was charged with forming a government.

citations.quote: İkinci dönem çalışmalarına başlayan TBMM’ye, İzmir milletvekili olarak katıldı.
Fethi Okyar hükümetinde Milli Eğitim Bakanı (1924- 1925) oldu.
Dördüncü ve Beşinci İnönü hükümetlerinde Maliye Bakanlığına (1927- 1930)

body.zh-Hant: 1942年7月9日起，他的第一屆政府（第13屆共和國政府）延續到1943年3月9日；1943年3月9日起的第二屆（第14屆）延續到1946年8月7日。1942年8月5日他在議會宣讀施政綱領時說，政府正竭盡注意與努力把國土留在戰爭之外。傳記總括他在1942至1946年間擔任首相。
body.en: His first government (the 13th Republican government) ran from 9 July 1942 to 9 March 1943; the second (the 14th), formed on 9 March 1943, lasted until 7 August 1946. Presenting the programme to the Assembly on 5 August 1942 he said the government was devoting all its attention and effort to keeping the country's territory out of the war. The biography sums up his premiership as running from 1942 to 1946.

citations.quote: 13. Cumhuriyet Hükümetinin (I. Saraçoğlu Hükümeti) Programını Sunuş
Topraklarımızı harbin dışında tutmak için bütün dikkat ve gayretimizi

body.zh-Hant: 土耳其大國民議會官網的歷任議長名單，把伊茲密爾的舒克魯·薩拉吉奧盧（1887至1953）列為第8屆第4、5立法年的議長，任期從1948年11月1日到1950年5月22日。傳記只簡述他1948年當選議長。
body.en: The Assembly's official list of speakers gives İzmir's Şükrü Saraçoğlu (1887–1953) as speaker for the 4th and 5th legislative years of the 8th term, from 1 November 1948 to 22 May 1950. The biography only notes briefly that he was elected speaker in 1948.

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館人名權威檔把埃德爾米羅·胡利安·法雷爾列為阿根廷政治人物，生年記為1887年、卒年1980年，並註明他是1944至1946年的總統。阿根廷總統府官網的歷任總統圖庫也把他列為1944至1946年的總統。
body.en: The German National Library authority record lists Edelmiro Julián Farrell as an Argentine politician born in 1887 and died in 1980, noting that he was president in 1944–1946. The Argentine presidency's official gallery of presidents likewise lists him for 1944–1946.

body.zh-Hant: 美國國務院歷史辦公室寫道，拉米雷斯在1944年1月26日與德國、日本斷交，數週後的2月25日把職位讓給副總統法雷爾將軍。同日美國駐阿根廷大使阿穆爾的電報說，拉米雷斯看來是被迫辭職，措詞後來由「辭職」改為「委託總統職權」給法雷爾；電報註腳稱法雷爾是戰爭部長兼副總統。
body.en: The U.S. Office of the Historian says that Ramírez broke relations with Germany and Japan on 26 January 1944 and a few weeks later, on 25 February, resigned in favor of his vice-president, General Farrell. The same day's telegram from the U.S. ambassador, Armour, says Ramírez's action seemed to have been taken under compulsion, with the wording changed from resignation to delegation of the presidential mandate to Farrell; a footnote identifies Farrell as Minister of War and Vice President.

citations.quote: broke relations with Germany and Japan on January 26, 1944
resigned in favor of his vice-president, General Edelmiro Farrell
a few weeks later on February 25, 1944
It also seems clear that his action was taken under compulsion.
from “resignation” to “delegation of the Presidential mandate” to Farrell
Gen. Edelmiro Farrell, Minister of War and Vice President.

body.zh-Hant: 美國認為法雷爾政權並不贊同阿根廷所宣示的加入半球防衛政策，因此指示大使阿穆爾不與這個新政府建立正式關係，並在1944年6月27日指示阿穆爾返回華盛頓。1945年4月19日，美國正式承認法雷爾政府。
body.en: The United States believed the Farrell regime was not in sympathy with Argentina's declared policy of joining the defense of the hemisphere, instructed Ambassador Armour to refrain from official relations with the new government, and instructed him to return to Washington on 27 June 1944. On 19 April 1945 the United States formally recognized the Farrell government.

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館人名權威檔記載亞爾馬·哈馬舍爾德生於1862年2月4日、卒於1953年10月12日。法國國家圖書館權威檔也記他生於瑞典的圖納、卒於斯德哥爾摩，並稱他是法學家與政治人物，曾在1914至1917年任首相。
body.en: The German National Library authority record gives Hjalmar Hammarskjöld's birth as 4 February 1862 and death as 12 October 1953. The French National Library record also puts his birth at Tuna in Sweden and his death at Stockholm, and calls him a jurist and politician who was prime minister from 1914 to 1917.

heading.en: Jurist and Ministry of Justice official

body.zh-Hant: 國家百科全書（Nationalencyklopedin）的條目稱他是涉足民法、行政法與國際法的多面向法學家。1891年他成為烏普薩拉大學特殊私法教授，1893年起是新法律籌備委員會委員，1895至1901年任司法部法律事務處處長。
body.en: The Nationalencyklopedin entry describes him as a many-sided jurist working in civil law, administrative law and international law. In 1891 he became professor of special private law at Uppsala, from 1893 he was a member of the Nya lagberedningen law-drafting committee, and in 1895–1901 he was head of the legislative bureau of the Ministry of Justice.

body.en: The German National Library record says he was governor of Uppsala County in 1907–1930 and prime minister from 17 February 1914 to 30 March 1917. The Nationalencyklopedin calls him a conservative politician and gives his premiership as 1914–1917.
